I am 73, my land is only 5 mu, and there are just 2 people in my household, so I will keep my plan steady and manageable. I have farmed for 55 years, so I do not want to gamble on anything complicated. Because I can irrigate from a well, I will keep cotton as my main crop and give it the largest share of land, since that matches the way I farm and where my experience is strongest. I will still keep some maize and wheat so the farm is not all in one crop and so I have a more balanced year. I will use seeds that I trust, not the cheapest weak seed, and I will keep fertilizer at a moderate level because I want stable output without wasting money. I will also keep tillage simple and familiar. Cotton needs the most watching, so I will spray it more times than maize and wheat. With my age and labor situation, I will choose a plan that is careful, practical, and not too heavy to manage.
